On Tuesday morning, I called the surgery at 8:00am because I believed I had an eye infection. My eye was swollen and painful. I was on hold for 53 minutes and was first in the queue to be answered when the call suddenly cut off.

After nearly an hour on the phone with no response, I decided to drive to the surgery in person. I explained to reception that I had been calling since 8am and that my eye was swollen and possibly infected. I was told that it was “not an emergency” and was advised to go to a chemist for eye drops.

I followed this advice and went to the chemist, where I was given a cream. It did not work. I then had to go back again to get proper eye drops.

It is very concerning that reception staff, who are not medically qualified, are making decisions about whether something is urgent and advising patients on treatment. My eye was clearly swollen, and I felt dismissed rather than properly assessed.

The appointment system is also extremely frustrating. Being on hold for nearly an hour, only for the call to cut off, is unacceptable. It makes it very difficult to access care.

I also worry about elderly patients who may not be able to use mobile apps or online booking systems. If phone lines are not being answered properly, how are vulnerable patients expected to cope?

Overall, the access to care and communication at this surgery needs serious improvement.",null,[0,146]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pSaFZtSXlZV2hUTjNwRlgzbDVRMVZ5V25WalRVRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x89d5a701d0ce82b5!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjRhVmIyYWhTN3pFX3l5Q1VyWnVjTUE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pSaFZtSXlZV2hUTjNwRlgzbDVRMVZ5V25WalRVRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjizcHvgLKTAxWWPHsEHYL4HAAQoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjizcHvgLKTAxWWPHsEHYL4HAAQ0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDkwZVdnMGJGOWZSV2hCZFY5dmJqVTNTMkZaTlVRNVVUbFBPRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSVVVOWk5qTkxTR2xWV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sRFF6QlBiWGswTTFCSlVWRkhhM2xRZGxreGRuYxAB",["0x0:0x89d5a701d0ce82b5",null,1769440255863494,1769440255863494,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107204707146688351042/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Roy Salfarlie","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJfiWhSkQRSlSiItTvBZXSLmxOPgRKTxIZ-KLub6BH7F1YhxQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107204707146688351042?hl=en"],"107204707146688351042",null,11,1,null,[0,3,1],1,["11 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjizcHvgLKTAxWWPHsEHYL4HAAQ7LoGCBIoAA"]]]],null,"a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Daughter booked appointment for 2:30.
